test_cases.name: Create order with total under $500 - no approval needed
test_cases.description: Customer creates an order with total value $450. Verify order is created with pending status and does NOT require approval.

test_cases.name: Create order with total over $500 - requires approval
test_cases.description: Customer creates an order with total value $600. Verify order requires manager approval and manager is notified.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Order created with requires_approval=true, manager notification sent

test_cases.name: Boundary: order exactly $500 - approval threshold
test_cases.description: Create order with exactly $500.00. Boundary case: the rule is 'over $500' so $500.00 should NOT require approval.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Order at exactly $500.00 does NOT require approval (rule is strictly >$500)

test_cases.name: Boundary: order at $500.01 - just above threshold
test_cases.description: Create order with $500.01. This is just above the approval threshold.

test_cases.name: Premium customer gets free shipping
test_cases.description: Premium customer (lifetime_spending > $5000) creates an order. Verify shipping_fee = 0.

test_cases.name: Standard customer pays $9.99 shipping
test_cases.description: Standard customer creates an order. Verify shipping fee is $9.99.

test_cases.name: Cancel order that is not shipped
test_cases.description: Customer cancels an order with status=pending. Should succeed.

test_cases.name: Cannot cancel shipped order
test_cases.description: Customer tries to cancel an order with status=shipped. Should fail.
test_cases.expected_outcome: HTTP 400 - order cannot be cancelled after shipping

test_cases.name: Cannot order out-of-stock product
test_cases.description: Customer tries to order a product with stock_quantity=0. Should be rejected.

test_cases.name: Boundary: exactly zero stock
test_cases.description: Order a product with stock_quantity exactly 0.
test_cases.expected_outcome: HTTP 422 - cannot order product with zero stock

test_cases.name: Email confirmation sent within 5 minutes
test_cases.description: After order creation, verify email confirmation is sent within 5 minutes.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Email sent within 300 seconds of order creation

test_cases.name: Payment timeout marks order as failed
test_cases.description: Payment processing exceeds 30 seconds. Order must be marked as failed.

test_cases.name: Customer becomes premium after $5000 spending
test_cases.description: Customer's lifetime spending reaches exactly $5000.01. Verify premium status is granted.

test_cases.name: Product must have all required fields
test_cases.description: Create a product without a price field. Should fail validation.

test_cases.name: Order history retention — records exist after 7 years
test_cases.description: Verify archived orders from 7+ years ago are still accessible and not deleted.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Order record still exists and is retrievable
